description: The architecture lacks explicit TLS configuration and ACM certificate setup for API Gateway and other endpoints, potentially exposing sensitive ML data and model artifacts to interception.
The architecture lacks proper network boundary controls through VPC configuration, potentially exposing internal services to unauthorized access.
Use of unsafe serialization formats (like pickle) in model artifacts could lead to code execution when models are loaded.
Lack of proper access controls for model artifacts could lead to intellectual property theft or model tampering.
Insufficient anonymization of training data could lead to PII exposure through model outputs or data breaches.
Lack of load balancing and DNS configuration could lead to service disruptions and reduced reliability.
Lack of security scanning in the model registry could allow deployment of vulnerable or malicious models.
